（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

644 14/10/16 A.H.
Shanghai Municipal Council.

October 13th 1916.

（批：Entered A.S.C. Oct 15）

Sir,
Tang Shao Yi, 唐紹儀 and Hu Han Ming 胡漢民
arrived from Tientsin by the s.s. Shenking on
the 12th inst. The former motored to his residence
at 141/2 Range Road and the latter to the residence
of Dr. Sun Yat Sen 10 Rue Vallon Frenchtown.
They were met at the wharf by about 60 persons
but there was no demonstration.
The destitute rebels have posted a notice
in the Zien Oen 全安 teashop Rue Kraetzer, Frenchtown
calling a meeting there at 10 a.m. to-day.
They propose to divide into two bodies one of which
will call at the office for repatriation and the
other at the yamen of General Yang who will be
asked for a definite answer as to when he intends
to begin distributing the funds. Should no
favourable reply be received within two days stronger
measures are hinted at.
In view of the above General Yang sent a
request to the various Guilds asking them to
advance the repatriation money pending the arrival
of the Government grant. On the evening of the
12th inst representatives of the Guilds met
at the In Tsz Shang 一枝香 restaurant Soochow Road
to consider the proposal of General Yang but they
failed to arrive at a solution of the question.
It is reported that General Yang, if the
proposed transfer of the 10th division from Woosung
to the north takes place, proposes to replace them
with troops from Sungkiang, from Fongching and from
Chapei. He is also going to apply to Tuchun Feng
for a regiment which has recently been transferred from
the north to Nanking. It is 500 strong and could
replace the troops who he may have to transfer
to Woosung.

Your Obedient Servant,
/mmmmmmmmm
Chief Detective Inspector.

（批：K 13/10）
Captain Superintendent of Police.

（印章：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探科。）

644 14/10/16 A.H.
上海工部局。

1916年10月13日。

（批注：10月15日录入A.S.C.）

先生：

唐绍仪与胡汉民于本月12日乘“盛京”轮（s.s. Shenking）自天津抵达。前者乘车前往其位于虹口路141/2号的寓所，后者则前往法租界华伦路10号孙中山博士的寓所。约有60人在码头迎接他们，但未发生示威活动。

贫困的反叛者已在法租界克勒策尔路（Rue Kraetzer）的“全安”茶馆张贴告示，号召于今日上午10时在该处集会。他们计划分为两批，一批前往遣返办事处，另一批前往杨将军衙门，要求杨将军就何时开始发放款项给予明确答复。暗示若在两天内未得到满意答复，将采取更激烈的措施。

鉴于上述情况，杨将军向各会馆发出请求，请他们在政府拨款到达之前垫付遣返费用。本月12日晚，各会馆代表在苏州路的“一枝香”餐馆集会，审议杨将军的提议，但未能就该问题达成解决方案。

据报，如果第十师从吴淞调往北方的计划得以实施，杨将军拟以来自松江、枫泾和闸北的部队予以替换。他还打算向督军冯国璋申请调入一个团，该团最近刚从北方调至南京，兵力为500人，可用于替换他可能不得不调往吴淞的部队。

您的顺从仆人，
/mmmmmmmmm
总探长。

（批注：K 10月13日）
警察总监
